text: Kilmarnock defeated rivals Ayr United in Rory McKenzie's testimonial match, despite the midfielder missing a penalty.

On Saturday, Kilmarnock will begin their season with an away match against Brora Rangers, a team from the Highland League. This match not only marks the manager's inaugural competitive game in his role, but also serves as the debut for the nine new players he has recruited thus far.
First-half goals from strikers Bruce Anderson and Marley Watkins ensured Kilmarnock rounded off pre-season with a friendly win over Ballymena United.
Kilmarnock eased to a two-goal win over Highland League champions Brora Rangers in Stuart Kettlewell's first competitive game in charge.
This time two years ago, the Scots skooshed through as qualifying hosts, winning all six matches in Edinburgh.
